hookups.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('42 reservable campsites, each with 30-amp, 50-amp and 110 electrical outlets. Each site also has water and sewer hookup') + Reserve Florida unit details (all 42: Electric 50, Water, Sewer), read 2026-10-21

values.note: All 42 sites are back-in. The park says 'Most sites can accommodate an RV length of 40 feet; a few sites can accommodate a few feet longer'; Reserve Florida lists vehicle lengths of 32-62 ft, and several site descriptions warn the site is narrower and may not take some slide-outs and awnings (call the park).

sites.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The campground has 42 reservable campsites') + Reserve Florida search/details for facility 77 (42 units, PullInTypeName 'Back In', VehicleLength 32-62), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('The campground has one large bathhouse with laundry machines'; 'two washing machines and two dryers are available in the campground'), read 2026-10-21

booking.source: https://www.floridastateparks.org/parks-and-trails/john-pennekamp-coral-reef-state-park/experiences-amenities-0 ('For reservations, visit the Florida State Parks reservations website or call 800-326-3521') + Reserve Florida PlaceId 31, read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on floridastateparks.org and Reserve Florida: 42 back-in sites with 30/50-amp electric, water and sewer at every site, laundry in the campground bathhouse, reservable on Reserve Florida. Fees left (human-checked 2026-10-12; every unit still $36 + utility). max_rig_ft not set: the park says most sites take 40 ft and 'a few' longer while the booking site lists up to 62 ft (both in sites.note). Window and fcfs left inherited; showers not stated for campers. Note unchanged.
